name: notion
description: Connect duya to Notion: search content, read pages and databases, and create or update pages and records through the official Notion remote MCP endpoint.

interface.shortDescription: Search and edit your Notion workspace
interface.longDescription: Connect duya to your Notion workspace so it can search pages and databases, read content, and create or update pages and records. Uses the official Notion remote MCP endpoint (https://mcp.notion.com/mcp) with OAuth. Requires connecting the Notion account in the app connection settings.
